title: The MOB paradox: Outpatient funds vs. construction delays
summary: CBRE’s Q1 MOB Report shows surging demand and capital, but construction completions are at 25% of the 5-year average. To protect margins on $310/sq. ft. assets, health systems must eliminate delivery friction using unified, cloud-based project management.
